description: This Java source file defines a utility class 'FileHelper' that provides static methods to load resource files into strings or StringBuffers, perform macro substitutions, and handle template files. It facilitates reading resource files, skipping comment lines, and substituting macros in templates.

classes.name: FileHelper
classes.description: A utility class for loading resource files into strings or StringBuffers, with support for macro substitution and template processing.

methods.name: loadTemplate
methods.description: Loads a resource file into a StringBuffer, skipping lines that start with '##'.

methods.name: translateBuffer
methods.description: Translates a StringBuffer using macro substitutions provided by a MacroSource.

methods.name: translateSimpleBuffer
methods.description: Loads a template file and performs a single key/value macro substitution.

methods.name: translateBufferTemplate
methods.description: Loads a template file and performs macro substitutions using a provided MacroSource.
